translation: When the middle region is as if internal, it is the foot Greater Yin Spleen; when it moves it causes abdominal fullness, pain within the stomach, cold in the upper tube (stomach), inability to eat, and the lower back as if dwelling in water. Deep and rough is heaviness of the body, cold and painful foot and shin, vexation and fullness with inability to lie down, occasional cough with spitting of blood, and diarrhea with undigested food. When the rear region is as if internal, it is the foot Lesser Yin Kidney.
